Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1001035": Farah is on the Team Dune on-call rotation; as of 2026-02-04 the pager for this cycle is carried by Tomasz Nowak.  (about: Tomasz Nowak, Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1001029": As of 2026-02-04, Tomasz Nowak is the primary on-call for Team Dune for this cycle, instead of Farah.  (about: Tomasz Nowak, Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1001026": On the 2026-02-04 rotation day, Team Dune's on-call swapped and Tomasz Nowak carries the phone until the next rotation.  (about: Tomasz Nowak, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000944" [decision]: On 2025-12-17, Team Dune's standup decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write.  (about: Team Dune, indexer)
- memory_id "1000890": On 2025-11-21, Team Dune reported that the billing service's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send.  (about: billing service, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000862": As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service moved from Team Dune to the Ember team.  (about: Team Dune, Ember team, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000836": Team Dune holds its planning meeting every Wednesday.  (about: Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000832": On 2025-11-06, Team Dune reported that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send.  (about: Team Dune, indexer)
- memory_id "1000829" [constraint]: The billing service has no deploys from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 because of the peak season.  (about: billing service)
- memory_id "1000815" [constraint]: As of 2025-10-27, the scheduler deploys on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.  (about: scheduler)
- memory_id "1000757": As of 2025-10-15, the scheduler is owned by Team Dune; Team Atlas kept it until then.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Dune, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000753": As of 2025-10-15, the pager for the scheduler rings Team Dune instead of Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Dune, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000709" [decision]: On 2025-09-15, Team Dune decided that the reporting service will read from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger, Team Dune, event bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000596": On the 2025-07-30 rotation day, Farah handed the Team Dune pager to Tomasz Nowak.  (about: Tomasz Nowak, Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000470" [decision]: As of 2025-06-13, the scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node, because the fixed node turned every restart into a missed run.  (about: scheduler)
- memory_id "1000464": On 2025-06-12, Team Dune noticed that the notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000420" [decision]: Team Dune has switched to a monthly game day.  (about: Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000402" [constraint]: The billing service ships only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC.  (about: billing service)
- memory_id "1000286": The scheduler pulls per-job kill switches from the feature-flags service on every run.  (about: feature-flags service, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000241" [constraint]: The webhooks service ships only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: webhooks service)
Existing entity names: Tomasz Nowak, Farah, Team Dune, indexer, billing service, Ember team, reporting service, scheduler, Team Atlas, ledger, event bus, notifier, feature-flags service, webhooks service
